gems.title: 安昂传奇：最后的气宗
gems.summary: 派拉蒙和尼克宣布“降世神通”系列开发三部新的电影，仍是动画形式。第一部由《降世神通：最后的气宗》导演Lauren Montgomery执导，《最后的气宗》主创Bryan Konietzko和Michael DiMartino担任制片人。

gems.whyWatch: 经典《降世神通》以动画电影形式回归，狂喜粉丝与幻想迷不容错过。
gems.whyWatchEn: The beloved Avatar universe returns in a new animated feature—essential viewing for fans and fantasy lovers.
gems.audience: 《降世神通》粉丝与高品质动画爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of Avatar and admirers of high-quality animation.

gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯踏上了返回家乡的艰险旅程。

gems.whyWatch: 史诗归途，古希腊神话在大银幕上重新焕发磅礴生命力。
gems.whyWatchEn: A sweeping mythic journey that brings Homer's Odyssey to life with grandeur and emotional resonance.
gems.audience: 喜爱古典神话与英雄传奇的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers drawn to classical mythology and heroic legends.

gems.title: 蜘蛛侠：崭新之日
gems.summary: 重建普通生活后，彼得一边在大学完成学业、一边从事兼职以维持生计，同时仍肩负着守护纽约街头的蜘蛛侠责任。然而，当一个神秘力量从内部腐蚀这座城市的安全与秩序，彼得被迫再次披上战衣。他必须在强大的敌人与昔日纽带之间找到平衡，并重新定义英雄的意义。
gems.summaryEn: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to
gems.whyWatch: 回归平民视角的蜘蛛侠，在生活与责任之间展现最真实的英雄成长。
gems.whyWatchEn: A grounded Spider-Man story balancing everyday struggles with superhero duty—refreshingly human and heartfelt.
gems.audience: 喜欢蜘蛛侠与平民英雄叙事的漫威粉丝
gems.audienceEn: Marvel fans who love Spider-Man and grounded hero narratives.
